description: Verify an npm or PyPI package before installing it. Runs up to nine checks covering advisories, install scripts, typosquat and combosquat names, scope and declared-repository checks, and how the release differs from its predecessors, and answers safe, caution, block or does_not_exist with every reason labelled as fact or heuristic against its source. One call is one verification: the first each day is free, and later ones cost $0.05 in USDC when a wallet is configured.

name.description: Package name: left-pad or @scope/thing on npm, requests on PyPI.

version.description: Exact version to verify. Omit to verify the package rather than one release.

name: verify_package

checked_at.description: When the verdict was computed, ISO 8601 UTC.

dist_tag.description: The dist-tag a version-less request resolved through; null when a version was given.

code.description: Stable identifier for the check that produced this.

kind.description: "fact" for something verified, "heuristic" for a signal.

source.description: The dataset this was read from.

resolved_version.description: The release the checks ran against: the version asked for, or the registry's latest.

sources.description: The datasets consulted, by name and URL.

version.description: The version verified, or null if none was given.

title: Verify package
